# Harsh Verma

> GNOME contributor working on test infrastructure for GIMP and Red Hat's dogtail. NIT Hamirpur EE student.

Built GIMP's first end-to-end UI tests and the hermetic test sessions that headlined dogtail 2.1.0. Found and fixed two GIMP CVEs (CVE-2026-97185, CVE-2026-90947), credited by Red Hat. 25 merge requests merged across 7 projects.

Personal developer portfolio at heyharsh.me — single-page site covering projects, blog/journal posts, explorations, and contact info.
